security.honeypotTitle: Honeypot + tax check on every token
security.honeypotBody: GoPlus, Honeypot.is, RugCheck and de.fi are triangulated before any buy. If any flags critical, the snipe blocks fail-closed.
security.deployerBody: Every contract is checked against the deployer's prior tokens. Serial ruggers and high-abandonment wallets show a red banner before you can confirm.
security.lpLockBody: Team Finance / Unicrypt / PinkLock locks parsed out of the GoPlus lp_holders payload and surfaced with unlock countdowns, so there is no more checking a separate dashboard.
security.auditFooter: Audit reports for every shipped section live in /admin/audit-tracker. Nothing ships without industry-parity verification.

faq.a1: No. We never hold your keys. Trading is non-custodial across EVM and Solana via the user's connected wallet; the platform only signs server-attested transactions on the user's behalf when they explicitly opt in to auto-execute.
faq.a2: Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC, Avalanche, Solana.
faq.q3: How does the sniper bot prevent rug-pulls?
faq.a3: Five sequential safety gates fire on every snipe: honeypot, tax, holder concentration, liquidity depth, and a VTX AI risk assessment. Any single gate flagging blocks the snipe.
faq.a4: Holding ≥1,227,000 NAKA unlocks the Cult chambers (Conclave / Oracle / Sanctum): gated research, governance, and curated alpha. NAKA is not required to use the trading platform itself.
faq.a5: 0.4% on swaps, tiered subscriptions for Pro / Elite, and a small revenue share with builders launching through the milestone-gated launchpad.
faq.a6: No. The privacy policy in /privacy lists every third party we share data with (Sentry for error tracking, PostHog for opt-in product analytics, the chain RPCs you trigger by trading). We do not sell wallet addresses, trade history, or personal data to anyone.

cards.whaleBody: Real-time activity from every wallet you follow + cluster-detected smart-money convergence.
cards.sniperBody: Auto-execute on new pairs that pass the 5-gate safety flow. TP/SL/trailing executor included.
cards.vtxBody: Ask anything in plain English. The agent pulls live on-chain data, decodes contracts, and ranks risk.
cards.copyBody: Mirror proven wallets one-click or auto, with per-rule daily caps and per-token blacklists.
